title: Multi Source Backup Strategy
definition: A backup strategy that supports the backup of data from multiple sources to a single backup destination.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Imagine having a backup system that can save data from different places, like two drives, into one backup location. This way, you can protect more data with less effort.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: A multi-source backup strategy enables a backup system to perform backups from multiple data sources to a single backup destination. This allows for more efficient and comprehensive data protection.
difficulty_levels.expert: The multi-source backup strategy introduces a level of abstraction to the backup process, enabling it to handle multiple data sources simultaneously. This not only enhances efficiency but also allows for better resource allocation and more resilient data protection. Additionally, it provides insights into data distribution and redundancy, which can be valuable for data analysis and optimization.

extra_fields.insight: The conversation highlights the need for a backup strategy that can handle multiple data sources, emphasizing the importance of efficiency and comprehensive data protection.
